paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Australia
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between polarity scores and counts for Australia. The x-axis is labeled “Polarity scores” and ranges from -1.0 to 0.6 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “Counts” and ranges from 0 to 140000 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 20000. A single blue line with circular markers represents counts as they vary with polarity scores. Starting at a count of approximately 0 at a polarity score of -1.0, the line remains at approximately 0 counts up to a polarity score of -0.6, increasing to a count of around 18000 at a polarity score of -0.4.  The line then ascends to a peak of approximately 128000 counts at a polarity score of 0.1, followed by a decline to about 45000 counts at a polarity score of 0.3. It then decreases further to around 30000 counts at a polarity score of 0.5, with a final value of approximately 23000 counts at a polarity score of 0.6.
